snapshot_limitations: The ETH page reports sample counts for each named campaign; it does not state that these counts equal rows in the separate preprocessed feature archives.
The official directory listing provides rounded sizes and modification times, but no remote cryptographic checksums or row-level source crosswalk.
The linked preprocessing scripts currently describe filtering behavior, but the local archives do not bind their exact generator commit, raw input version, filter flags, or retained-row index map.
